description: Returns a one-time upload address for the 3D file (STEP, STL or 3MF) of a part to be overmolded. Once the file is uploaded to that address, the portal analyzes it in a draft project of the connected Fillio account; nothing is sent to Fillio until the project is submitted (submit_part_check, or by the user in the portal). Requires the user's Fillio account to be connected (authorization given in the portal, or a token). Useful to check a design before handing it to the user.

file_name.description: Name of the 3D file, with its extension (.step, .stp, .stl or .3mf).

project.description: Number of a project already checked with this account (DEM-…), to upload a new version to it. Empty for a new project.

project_name.description: Project name, for a new project. Defaults to the file name.

resin.description: Overmolding resin: polyamide, urethane, silicone, or advise (Fillio's choice, the default).

name: start_part_check
title: Part check request
